name: Japan Business Systems, Inc.
summary: Japan Business Systems, Inc. provides cloud integration and related services. The company operates through three segments: Cloud Integration, Cloud Service, and License & Products. It develops, implements, establishes, and monitors cloud migration plans; implements Microsoft Cloud services; and offers maintenance, operation, and support services to enhance cloud utilization, focusing on Microsoft Cloud. The company also engages in the provision of cloud solutions, licenses, equipment for on-premise infrastructure, and private cloud services; and resale of related equipment. In addition, it offers Microsoft 365; Microsoft power platform; security; cloud manufacture solutions; hybrid meetings;…
